भल्लट a poet under Śaṅkaravarman, Rājataraṅgiṇī 5, 203,
wrote:
 Bhallaṭaśataka. Oppert 6078. II, 1122. 6130.
8906.

. Printed in Kāvyamālā
4, 140. He is quoted by Kṣemendra in
Kavikaṇṭhābharaṇa 2, 1. 5, 1 in Aucityavicā-
racarcā 26, Śp. p. 61. Sbhv.
 Padamañjarī lex. Oppert 5567.

भल्लालसंग्रह dh. by Bhallāla. Oppert II, 4783. Kamalā-
kara in the Nirṇayasindhu spells Bhallāṭa.

भालुकि an authority on yoga, quoted in Haṭhapradīpikā
W. p. 196, on medicine in Ṭoḍarānanda W. p. 289.

भालुकि an authority on medicine, quoted in Ātaṅkada-
rpaṇa,

भाल्लविन् pl. the name of a vaidic Śākhā. Quoted in
Baudhāyanadharmasūtra 1, 2, 11.
